Author: ssalazar217 (SteSE)
Name: EchoXIV
Description:
EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple free engines (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores gratuitos (Google, Papago, EchoXIV Translate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.
Punchline: Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.
Changelog:
v1.0.2.0:
- Added EchoXIV Translate (LibreTranslate) as a dedicated unlimited translation engine, alongside the new Yandex engine.
- Expanded local AI support for OpenAI-compatible servers such as LM Studio and Ollama, including model configuration, connection checks, timeout control, disabled thinking mode, and configurable response token limits.
- Added configurable translation-engine fallback with automatic recovery checks for the primary engine.
- Prevented repeated failover loops when a local AI server returns an empty response or is unavailable.
- Added destination-language context to translation requests and logs to make the requested output language explicit.
- Added single-request AI romanization: the model can return the translated text and its romanized form together as structured JSON.
- Updated the translated-chat window to display romanized output while preserving the original translated text and source text according to the message direction.
- Applied configuration changes immediately when settings are modified, including language, engine, fallback, and romanization options.
- Fixed Papago integration using its current web endpoint and improved translation error handling.
